text:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] Repeated region health-check oscillation detected. Observed probe flips across us-east <-> us-west <-> eu for the last 12m. Rate ~2 flips/min. Symptoms: routing fallbacks, elevated p99 latency, ~3% 5xxs on hosted-api model routes. Pager: @lena (oncall). Severity: P1.

lena (oncall): I'm on it. Paging SREs and runtime. @mike @jamie can you take initial triage? Any known deploys?

mike (eng-runtime): No recent deploys in the runtime cluster. Pulling probe and routing logs now. Quick guess: health probe thresholds too aggressive or a bad recovery policy causing oscillation.

jamie (SRE): Confirming spike in health-check flaps in telemetry. See continuous up/down for nodes in us-west and eu, then requests bouncing to us-east and back. I'll grab the last 30m of probe traces.

clarisse (product): We're seeing increased error rates in the dashboard for several customers (dashboard-ids: C-421, C-733, C-981). Can ops scope customer-facing impact?

mike (eng-runtime): Pasting current routing/probe config from nearest-prod (sanitized):

```yaml
routing_policy:
  - region: us-east
    priority: 1
  - region: us-west
    priority: 2
  - region: eu
    priority: 3
health_probe:
  interval_ms: 500
  failure_threshold: 1
  recovery_threshold: 1
  jitter_ms: 0
```

mike (eng-runtime): Problem: failure_threshold and recovery_threshold set to 1 with 500ms interval — super sensitive. Any transient network blip bounces a region in/out and we immediately fall back and back. That matches the sawtooth pattern.

jamie (SRE): Agreed. Also noticing some probe timeouts ~200-300ms from eu to upstream infra; combined with thresholds=1 equals flip.

lena (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) Add immediate suppression: escalate failure_threshold -> 3, recovery_threshold -> 2, interval_ms -> 2000. 2) Add random jitter to probes. 3) Temporarily pin high-traffic customers to their current region (sticky routing) to avoid cascading fallbacks. Who can push the policy change?

mike (eng-runtime): I can push a temporary routing-policy patch to the control plane. Doing an immediate patch to the policy for affected stacks. Command I'll run (no prod token pasted here):

```bash
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/admin/routing/update -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"selector":"region:*","health_probe":{"interval_ms":2000,"failure_threshold":3,"recovery_threshold":2,"jitter_ms":300}}'
```

mike (eng-runtime): Patch applied to 70% of control-plane nodes (rolling). Watching traffic and flips.

jamie (SRE): I'm enabling sticky routing for the top 5 affected customers now (manual override). That should reduce error amplification while patch rolls.

clarisse (product): Noted. Logged affected customer contacts and outbound comms placeholders. Severity message ready if we see >5% errors persist.

incidents-bot: [NOTIFICATION] Routing policy patch deployed by mike (eng-runtime) to 70% of nodes. Observability: probe-flip-rate dropping in 5m window.

mike (eng-runtime): Flip rate dropped ~80% on nodes with the patch. p99 latency trending down from 1.9s -> 650ms. 5xx rate for the hosted-api routes on patched nodes dropped from ~3.1% -> 0.6%.

jamie (SRE): Continuing to monitor. I'll coordinate a controlled rollout to 100% over the next 15m and keep sticky overrides for 20m to avoid thrash.

lena (oncall): Good. Any short-term customer impact estimate?

clarisse (product): Preliminary: 4 customers saw transient errors (less than 10 min) with one larger customer (C-421) showing degraded latency for ~12 minutes. No data loss. Support tickets opened: #SUP-1192, #SUP-1193.

mike (eng-runtime): Rollout to 100% complete. Verifying probe metrics now.

incidents-bot: [METRIC] probe.flip_rate (window=1m): before=2.1/min, after_patch=0.3/min. p99 latency baseline=480ms, spike=1.9s, post=520ms.

jamie (SRE): Flaps subsiding. I'll remove sticky overrides in 20m after confirming stability. Also scheduling a short maintenance note to adjust defaults.

lena (oncall): Thanks team. Handoff: @jamie you're on post-incident ownership for the PM/RTB and postmortem. Actions to include:
- Update default probe thresholds (interval_ms >= 1500, failure_threshold >= 2, recovery_threshold >= 2)
- Add hysteresis/backoff for region failover
- Add an oscillation detector alert (pattern: flip_count >= 5 in 10m)
- Add canary for routing-policy changes (deploy gate)

jamie (SRE): Ack. Creating ticket INF-4572 with those items and linking this thread. I'll own the postmortem and timeline.

clarisse (product): I'll coordinate customer comms, send a short summary to affected accounts once final impact numbers confirmed.

mike (eng-runtime): We'll also audit any recent config changes that might have reduced jitter/default thresholds. Initial blame seems config drift in a zone template applied last week.

incidents-bot: [RESOLVE] System metrics stable for 25m. No new flips detected in the last 10m. P1 -> downgraded to P2 for postmortem work.

lena (oncall): Handoff complete to jamie for follow-up. Closing active page. Great coordination — quick and effective. :thumbsup:

jamie (SRE): I'll post the postmortem and remediation plan in #postmortems within 24h.
